dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250829-SDN-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250829-SDN-01) A flood occurred on Aug 29 2025 in Sudan. It affected an estimated 566831 people and 805036 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
